changelog: Every API route is now a thin adapter: the logic moved out of `src/app/api` into a new `src/server` service layer (agent, alerts, elders, habits, auth, app), whose modules return a status plus a body so that `src/server/http.ts` is the only place that speaks HTTP. URLs, verbs, status codes and payloads are unchanged - only the framework's NextAuth handler stays where it is. The stale `src/lib/...` paths the earlier module splits left behind in README and code comments are corrected. Previous release: `intentDictionary` and `fraudSentinel` split into module folders behind unchanged import paths.
